Approval
of Roadmap. The PCA, in coordination with the Office of

Funding
The initial funding for the Roadmap shall be sour
from the money and funds constituting the Coconut Levy and Coco Levy Assets.
The initial funding shall be released upon approval of the Roadmap b
President, and upon compliance with all existing applicable laws and
accounting, and auditing rules and regulations.

Utilization of Funds. The funds, once released, shall be utilized
PCA together with the government agencies involved in the Roadmap only for the p
for which such funds have been allocated and released, and in all cases only
benefit of the coconut farmers and for the development of the coconut industry.
The PCA shall prepare a monthly cash program and shall render an annual r
to the President, which shall be considered in the preparation of the annual bud

To ensure the implementation, coordination, and integration of national ef

Separability.
If any provision of this Order is declared inv
unconstitutional, the other provisions not affected thereby shall remain
subsisting.

Repeal. All other orders, rules, regulations and issuances or
thereof which are inconsistent with this Order are hereby
repealed or
accordingly.

Effectivity.
This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
